content.text: How do I know if I have a valid personal injury case?Someone else’s negligence leading to your injury could make you eligible for a case. To find out whether your claim has merit, you should arrange a complimentary meeting with one of our seasoned personal injury lawyers. For California residents who wish to file a personal injury claim, they must adhere to a two-year limit from the accident date. After examining all relevant details, our team will provide guidance on your optimal legal strategy according to California statutes. How much will it cost to hire a personal injury lawyer?Hillguard Injury Lawyers operates on a contingency fee structure where you owe us nothing unless we secure a victory for your case. Our fees depend on the compensation we obtain for you which means you don’t pay any initial costs to begin. California’s legal system provides high-quality legal representation to all individuals no matter their income level. Our free consultations allow us to assess your case and provide legal assistance without any financial obligation for you. How soon should I contact a lawyer after an accident??Following an accident, you should reach out to a personal injury lawyer immediately to protect your rights. Starting the investigation of your case as early as possible increases our ability to collect essential evidence and achieve the compensation you deserve. Personal injury claimants in California generally have two years to file their lawsuits according to the statute of limitations although claims against government entities may require filing sooner due to shorter timeframes. Postponing action may diminish your potential for a successful claim, so immediate contact with your lawyer is essential.
